ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major indices slipped overnight, with BTC falling 3.2% and ETH 4.5%, while XRP plunged over 9% after the Senate rejected the Clarity Act. Negative political news and lingering Fed rate‑hike speculation are weighing on risk assets, and a BIS report highlighted gaps in on‑chain transfer data. New token listings on Delta India provide limited upside amid the broader downtrend.
